description: URPD curves: coin supply bucketed by the price at which each UTXO last moved (its cost basis)
known_limitations: TWO SOURCES, ONE STORE: current charts come from the live host (charts-cdn.checkonchain.com), the dated history from the frozen GitHub mirror (last data commit 2026-02-19) and our raw cache. `tree_sha` is the mirror revision the history came from -- it is not a freshness signal.
The 14-day diff window is retired upstream: the live host 404s it. It is skipped outright rather than summed from mixed vintages; live windows are 30/90/180/365d.
Live charts bucket at $500, the mirror generation at $200. Each dated curve keeps the grid it arrived on and the two are never merged into one curve.

Where the source's own charts disagree, the value carried by the most charts wins: on 2026-09-20 the live snapshot page's curve is 17.79M BTC against the six live diff charts' 20.09M for the same day, and the diff family is the one its own history corroborates.
`price_usd` rides along in every series chart and those copies differ (median 0.2% in 2022-2026, up to 30% before 2016); the most-supported copy is kept rather than whichever chart listed first.
BTC-UTXO-only (no ETH equivalent) -- URPD is a UTXO-chain concept.
Third-party computed: derived by checkonchain's own node, not this project's.
Public free chart pages (Plotly payloads in static HTML); robots-permitted, commercial brand content -- treat as investigation artifact.
Historical dated curves are source-computed for fixed windows; the curve store is what makes arbitrary date pairs possible.
The $0 price bucket holds ~2.8M BTC and is excluded from overlay series.
